en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a church with a tall central tower topped by a lantern and cross. The building has a classical facade, arched windows, and a staircase leading up from a tree‑lined forecourt. Several small figures are visible near the entrance. At the bottom of the image, printed in red text, are the words "Carl Johans Kyrka." on the left and "Göteborg." on the right.
